# Test sources

Tests generate synthetic candidate records using the exact column contracts in `schemas.json`. Names are generic examples. Deliberately malformed encoding is synthetic and tests preservation plus a visible quality flag. Tests cover missing cells, distinct winner/candidate vote fields, leading zeroes, duplicate observations, malformed rows, and interrupted output writes.

The original CSVs have no complete request/capture manifest, and no source HTML is retained here. Capture times are unknown. No new live data were collected for these tests.
